3.name: Experimental Elixir & Tool Proficiency (Alchemist)
3.description: Gain Alchemist's Supplies proficiency and brew Experimental Elixirs after a Long Rest or by expending spell slots.

6.name: Alchemical Savant (Alchemist)
6.description: When casting an Artificer spell through Alchemist's Supplies, add your INT modifier to one healing roll or Acid, Fire, Necrotic, or Poison damage roll.

10.name: Restorative Reagents (Alchemist)
10.description: Experimental Elixirs grant bonus Temporary HP, and you can cast Lesser Restoration INT modifier times per Long Rest without a slot.

14.name: Chemical Mastery (Alchemist)
14.description: Gain Resistance to Acid and Poison damage and Immunity to the Poisoned condition, and cast Greater Restoration and Heal once per Long Rest without slots.

3.name: Arcane Armor & Tools of the Trade (Armorer)
3.description: Gain Heavy Armor and Smith's Tools proficiency and transform armor into Guardian or Infiltrator Arcane Armor.

6.name: Armor Modifications (Armorer)
6.description: Your Arcane Armor separates into distinct boots, bracers, chestpiece, and weapon slots for Plans/Replicate Magic Item and increases your known magic item plans.

10.name: Improved Arcane Armor (Armorer)
10.description: Enhance your Arcane Armor's model weapon strikes and defensive capabilities across Guardian and Infiltrator modes.

14.name: Perfected Armor (Armorer)
14.description: Maximize your Guardian/Infiltrator Arcane Armor effects, pulling foes into melee or unleashing intensified lightning strikes.

3.name: Eldritch Cannon & Artillerist Spells (Artillerist)
3.description: Gain Woodcarver's Tools proficiency, prepare Artillerist spells, and summon a Magical Eldritch Cannon (Flamethrower, Force Ballista, or Protector).

6.name: Arcane Firearm (Artillerist)
6.description: Inscribe a wand, staff, or rod as an Arcane Firearm to add 1d8 extra damage to one damage roll of your Artificer spells.

10.name: Explosive Cannon (Artillerist)
10.description: Your Eldritch Cannon damage/healing rolls scale by +1d8, and you can command it to detonate in a 20-foot-radius Force blast.

14.name: Fortified Position (Artillerist)
14.description: Maintain two Eldritch Cannons at once and grant Half Cover to yourself and allies within 10 feet of them.

eldritch_cannon.name: Eldritch Cannon
eldritch_cannon.hint: Bonus Action activates your Eldritch Cannon (Force Ballista, Flamethrower, or Protector).

arcane_firearm.name: Arcane Firearm
arcane_firearm.hint: Add extra damage to one damage roll of an Artificer spell cast through your Arcane Firearm.

3.name: Battle Ready & Steel Defender (Battle Smith)
3.description: Use INT for magic weapon attacks, gain Smith's Tools proficiency, keep Battle Smith spells prepared, and command a Steel Defender companion.

6.name: Arcane Jolt (Battle Smith)
6.description: Channel stored magic on weapon or Steel Defender hits to deal extra Force damage or heal an ally within 30 feet (INT mod uses per Long Rest).

10.name: Steel Defender Resilience (Battle Smith)
10.description: Further empower your Steel Defender and Arcane Jolt support for frontline protection.

14.name: Improved Defender (Battle Smith)
14.description: Arcane Jolt scales to 4d6, your Steel Defender gains +2 AC, and Deflect Attack deals 1d4 + INT modifier Force damage.

arcane_jolt.name: Arcane Jolt
arcane_jolt.hint: Once per turn on a magic weapon or Steel Defender hit: deal extra Force damage or heal an ally within 30 ft.

3.name: Tools of the Trade & Adventurer's Atlas (Cartographer)
3.description: Gain Calligrapher's Supplies and Cartographer's Tools proficiency (halving Spell Scroll scribing time and cost), keep Cartographer spells prepared, and link allies with Adventurer's Atlas maps.

6.name: Guided Precision & Portal Jump (Cartographer)
6.description: Enhance Adventurer's Atlas allies with extra precision and short-range spatial repositioning between mapped coordinates.

10.name: Ingenious Movement (Cartographer)
10.description: Use your Flash of Genius or Atlas links to help allies escape danger and traverse battlefield hazards effortlessly.

14.name: Superior Atlas (Cartographer)
14.description: Protect your Adventurer's Atlas holders from lethal hits with emergency rescue teleports and expand your magical cartography network.
